correctness.rationale: The odd-index-difference case is parity-exact. In the even case the symmetric denominator pairing is exact, every odd power-sum unit-class recurrence is checked algebraically for all exponents and depths, and the infinite 2-adic tail has strictly greater valuation than its leading term. Therefore v2(O_b-O_a)=v2(b²-a²) with no unproved hypotheses. The packaged checker confirms 3240 exact rational pairs and 29160 modular equivalences.

value.rationale: All modular collisions of a classical rational sequence are classified exactly by equality of squared indices modulo powers of two. This is strictly richer than the known single-index valuation and not a tiny finite enumeration: it supplies infinite uniform shifted-sum identities and an unexpected quadratic 2-adic metric.
